entities.summary: Yousaf Raza Gilani is a Pakistani politician who served as the 16th prime minister of Pakistan from 2008 to 2012. He is currently serving as chairman of the senate of Pakistan since 2024. A member of the Pakistan People's Party (PPP), Gilani remains the country's first and only ethnic Saraiki prime minister.
